latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Amazon product differentiation strategy tool.

- Analyze competitor weaknesses and extract pain points from negative reviews
- Identify unique selling points (USPs) from positive reviews
- Generate actionable differentiation strategies and an improvement roadmap
- Supports progressive analysis from basic comparison to full strategy, based on available data (L1-L4)
- Outputs include competitor matrix, pain points, USPs, market gaps, positioning recommendations, and prioritized actions
- No API key required for use
